business_summary: Pan Pacific International Holdings Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates retail stores in Japan and North America. The company operates discount stores under the Don Quijote, MEGA Don Quijote and MEGA Don Quijote UNY, Nagasakiya, and Olympic names; general supermarkets stores under the Apita, Piago, and Robin Hood names; and retail stores under the Picasso, OSC Amaike, Miuraya, Don Quijote USA, Gelson's Markets, okyo Central and Marukai Markets, Don Don Donki, and Times brand names. It is also involved in leasing space management; tenant leasing; provision of internet services; and development and procurement of products and control of production. In addition, the company provides products under the private brand names, including JONETZ, Robin Hood, EveryDay Real Price, RESTORATION, ACTIVEGEAR, greenstage, cosparade, me&do, Henai Meshi, and eco!on. The company was formerly known as Don Quijote Holdings Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Pan Pacific International Holdings Corporation in February 2019. Pan Pacific International Holdings Corporation was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Pan Pacific International Holdings Corporation은 자회사와 함께 일본과 북미에서 소매점을 운영하고 있습니다. 회사는 Don Quijote, MEGA Don Quijote 및 MEGA Don Quijote UNY, Nagasakiya 및 Olympic 이름으로 할인점을 운영하고 있습니다. Apita, Piago 및 Robin Hood 이름으로 일반 슈퍼마켓 매장; Picasso, OSC Amaike, Miuraya, Don Quijote USA, Gelson's Markets, okyo Central 및 Marukai Markets, Don Don Donki 및 Times 브랜드의 소매점. 임대 공간 관리에도 참여합니다. 임차인 임대; 인터넷 서비스 제공; 제품 개발 및 조달과 생산 관리. 또한 JONEZZ, Robin Hood, EveryDay Real Price, RESTORATION, ACTIVEGEAR, greenstage, cosparade, me&do, Henai Meshi, eco!on 등 PB 브랜드로 제품을 제공하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Don Quijote Holdings Co., Ltd.로 알려졌으며 2019년 2월에 Pan Pacific International Holdings Corporation으로 이름을 변경했습니다. Pan Pacific International Holdings Corporation은 1980년에 설립되었으며 일본 도쿄에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
